rule: Each row declares one InTr crossing from this repository to a repository of this organization named in resident-runtime/intr_intra_org_destination.py INTRA_ORG_DESTINATIONS, whose chain is a subtree of refs/stegverse/organization-ledger. Landing a row on main is the transition: after that push's main-merge transfer is ledgered, .github/workflows/intr-path-transfer.yml appends the destination's registration genesis, this repository's source receipt and the destination repository's ingress receipt, each consumed by an organization receipt. A crossing already ledgered is answered from the ledger. No dispatch.
